rubric.low: Standard, necessary for the service, or protective of the user (consent, deletion, notice, limited retention, no sale).
rubric.medium: A real trade-off with a bounded effect: limited sharing for marketing, retention for a stated period, termination or changes without notice.
rubric.high: Broad, open-ended or hard-to-reverse effect on personal data or money: selling or sharing data for others' own purposes, indefinite retention, background tracking for ads, perpetual licences, biometric reuse, forfeiture.
rubric.pdpl: potential_concern = the clause's own wording conflicts with a PDPL principle; no_concern_identified = the clause is consistent with it (often protective); only clear cases are labelled.
rubric.level: The level the backend formula gives for the gold severities of the document.

documents.title: Sanad Fitness privacy policy
documents.terms_text:
Sanad Fitness Privacy Policy

1. What we collect. Sanad records your workouts, steps and heart rate. This data stays on your phone unless you turn on cloud backup.

2. Cloud backup. If you turn on cloud backup, your workout data is encrypted and stored on servers in Saudi Arabia. You can turn backup off at any time, and the backup copy is deleted within 7 days.

3. Advertising. Sanad does not show advertisements and does not sell or rent your personal data to anyone.

4. Sharing. We share data only with the hosting provider that stores encrypted backups, and only to run the service. We disclose data to authorities only when the law requires it.

5. Your choices. You can export or delete all your data from the Settings screen. Deleted data is removed from our servers within 30 days.

6. Children. Sanad is not intended for children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their data.

7. Changes. If we change this policy we will notify you in the app at least 30 days before the change takes effect.

documents.terms_text:
Lamha Terms of Service

1. Your content. You keep ownership of the photos you post. By posting, you grant Lamha a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide licence to use, copy, modify, sublicense and sell your photos, including after you delete them.

2. Face recognition. Lamha scans the faces in every photo you upload to create face templates, and uses these templates and your photos to train machine-learning models that we may license to other companies.

3. Visibility. New accounts are public by default. You can switch your account to private in Settings.

4. Location tags. The app adds your exact location to each photo you post unless you turn this off.

5. Deleting photos. You can delete a photo at any time, and deleted photos are removed from your profile immediately.

6. Disputes. Any dispute must be resolved through binding arbitration, and you waive your right to join a class action.

7. Age. You must be at least 13 years old to use Lamha.

٧. المسؤولية. لا يتحمل المتجر أي مسؤولية عن التأخير في التوصيل الناتج عن شركات الشحن.

٥. الحماية. تُخزن البيانات مشفرة على خوادم داخل المملكة العربية السعودية.

٦. التعديلات. نخطرك داخل التطبيق قبل ١٤ يومًا من أي تعديل جوهري على هذه السياسة.
